decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

323/L/01, 323/L/02, 323/L/03 (Rev B), 323/L/04 (Rev A), 323/L/05, 323/L/06, Site Location Plan, Design and Access Statement prepared by KP Architects (dated 24/09/2025), Wall Inspection Report prepared by Horwitz Associates (dated 16/09/2025), Arboricultural Impact Assessment  & Method Statement Report ref. AIA/MF/0199/25 dated October 2025 (prepared by Marcus Foster Arboricultural Design & Consultancy)

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and policies DH1 and DH2 of the Hampstead Neighbourhood Plan 2025. 
Condition : 4 - Prior to the commencement of works on site, tree protection measures shall be installed and working practices adopted in accordance with the document entitled Arboricultural Impact Assessment  & Method Statement Report ref. AIA/MF/0199/25 dated October 2025 (prepared by Marcus Foster Arboricultural Design & Consultancy). All trees on the site, or parts of trees grow from adjoining sites, unless shown on the permitted drawings as being removed, shall be retained and protected from damage in accordance with BS5837:2012 and with the approved protection details. The development shall be monitored by the project arboriculturalist in accordance with the approved report.
 


Reason: To ensure that the development will not have an adverse effect on existing trees and in order to maintain the character and amenity of the area in accordance with the requirements of policies A2 and A3 of the Camden Local Plan
Condition : 5 - Prior to the commencement of construction, detailed drawings confirming the tree root arch(es) and a sample panel of the rebuilt wall shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The required details shall include:

1. Detail elevation drawing showing the location and dimensions of the tree root arche(s) shall be submitted at 1:50 and arch details at 1:25.
2. Material specifications and a sample panel showing the proposed rebuilt wall details - demonstrating the bond pattern (Flemish), mortar mix (lime based), pointing profile and finish (flush brushed) and physical samples of any additional bricks required (salvaged brown), and material of the stucco base.
3. Evidence that the project arboriculturist has contributed to the design of the tree root arche(s).

Reason: In order to safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the building in accordance with the requirements of policy D2 of the Camden Local Plan 2017.
description: Rebuilding of part of garden wall facing Heath Street, above existing plinth.
